skill.title: 等待必须受有效截止时间约束
skill.invariant: A readiness wait must have an effective local or propagated outer deadline.
applicability: Asynchronous readiness waits that may otherwise remain pending
exceptions: A verified outer deadline propagates cancellation to the wait
The operation is already bounded by its API contract
